visual_synopsis: A jumpy man in a lime green shirt and black tie comes home with a rolled-up document and argues with his wife (a male actor in a blonde wig and pink coat) first in the bare entryway and then in their teal-painted kitchen, where the only food is a boiled egg and a scoop of mash on two chipped plates. A heavy man in a black suit then arrives and the two men sit side by side at the carpet-covered table in a stiff, deferential conversation while the wife hovers in the doorway clutching a frying pan and laughing.
